items.docs: This endpoint is still on our legacy API. Get historical trips data for specified vehicle. This method returns a set of historical trips data for the specified vehicle in the specified time range. **Submit Feedback**: Likes, dislikes, and API feature requests should be filed as feedback in our API feedback form.
